subject: general
question:
Simplify the given expression.

(5 + 5 times 5)/(5 times 5 + 5)times (frac{1)/(5)div ((1)/(5)times (1)/(5))}{((1)/(5)times (1)/(5))div (1)/(5)}-(5-(1)/(5))times (10)/(2)
solution:
**Formula used:**

BODMAS

B - Brackets

O - Of

D - Division

M - Multiplication

A - Addition

S - Subtraction

Preference will be given on the basis of the letters coming first in the word BODMAS.**
Calculations:**

(5 + 5 times 5)/(5 times 5 + 5)times (frac{1)/(5)div ((1)/(5)times (1)/(5))}{((1)/(5)times (1)/(5))div (1)/(5)}-(5-(1)/(5))times (10)/(2) 

= (30)/(30)times (frac{1)/(5)div (1)/(25)}{(1)/(25)div (1)/(5)}-((24)/(5))times 5 

= 1 × 25 - 24

= 25 - 24

= 1

**Hence, The value required is 1.**
